simple.meaning: רְאוּבֵנִי (Rᵉʼûwbênîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Numbers 26:7. The surrounding context includes family, kingship, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְאוּבֵנִי (H7206) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רְאוּבֵנִי (Rᵉʼûwbênîy) / H7206 is traced through Numbers 26:7, Numbers 34:14, Deuteronomy 3:12, Deuteronomy 3:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben

firstOccurrence.englishText: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

timeline.evidenceText: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,
Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:
Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

All these were men of war, who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

His brothers, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

definitions.short: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
definitions.full: H7206. Reubeni רְאוּבֵנִי adjective, of a people of foregoing; of individual 1Chr 11:42 a; with article as substantive collective הָראוּבֵנִי Num 26:7 ; 34:14 (both P), Josh 13:8 (D; + הַגָּדִי ), 2Kin 10:33 ( + id. + הַמְנַשִּׁי ), 1Chr 12:38 (van d. H. v. 12:37 ; + הַגָּדִי + מְנַשֶּׁה שֵׁבֶט חֲצִי ), 26:32 ( id. ); לָראוּבֵנִי 5:6 ; 27:16 , + וְלַגָּדִי (+ sometimes מ שֵׁבֶט ׳חֲצִי ) Deut 3:12 , 16 ; 29:7 ; Josh 1:12 ; 12:6 ; 22:1 (all D), 1Chr 5:26 , compare Deut 4:43 . רְאִית רְאָיָה, רֳאִי, רְאִי, ראות, see ראה . רְאֵים see ראישׁון רְאֵם see רִאשׁוֺן . p. 911, below
